species.tagline: A wide round flap on her belly

tasks.title: Look at her belly
tasks.message: A female has a wide, round flap on her belly to hold her eggs.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a female mangrove crab. Look at the wide round flap on her belly.

tasks.title: Compare with the male
tasks.message: A male's flap is narrow and pointed; a female's is round and wide. Now you can tell them apart.
tasks.subtitle: Narrow and pointed means male. Round and wide means female. Now you know!

tasks.title: Help her
tasks.message: She needs clean water to raise her eggs.
tasks.subtitle: Clean water is how she raises her eggs. Thank you!
